## Historical audit: S0041

**Source for all citations:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/quota_restored_20261103/retired/results/external/fixed_h0/selected/external/bw_0011/trajectory.jsonl`. Character ranges below identify the supplied complete observations, not inferred subspans.

| Evidence | Observation and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Student `model_request`, JSONL line 1, chars [0,6261) | The requested goal was to reconstruct a clean laboratory from one photograph: blue paneled walls, curved skirting, floor and ceiling, exposed overhead elements, a glass-fronted stainless cabinet, dandelion feature wall and digital display. The prompt requested distinct materials, unobstructed subjects, corner perspective and even lighting. The fixed runner, not the program, was to save and render. These are **requested scene features**, not observed geometry or results. |
| Student `codex_session`, line 2, chars [0,2630) | A fresh, read-only session received an image path and prompt; the session reported failure, exit code 1, and zero tool calls. No student program, scene modification or autonomous exploration is visible. |
| Student `model_error`, line 3, chars [0,550); `scene_error`, line 4, chars [0,1613) | The first model request failed when the Codex student process exited 1. The traceback points to a stderr log, but its contents are not provided; the underlying cause is unknown. |

**Outcome and validation.** This is a **technical interruption**, not evidence of algorithm failure, partial correctness, or an empty patch. No successful build, render inspection, formal success result or geometric validation is visible. The photograph itself is not supplied as viewable audit evidence here, so its contents and camera match cannot be independently assessed. Multiple objects, material differentiation, textures, part connections, pose, and camera, lighting or render problems are consequently unverified; their presence in the prompt is not evidence of implementation.

**Teacher and lessons.** No teacher input, detection, diagnosis, proposed update, execution or adoption appears in this student trace. A transferable operational lesson is to inspect the actual error log before diagnosing a failed model session; its absence leaves the cause unresolved. The laboratory layout and material requirements are task-specific, not demonstrated solutions. It remains unknown whether a retry would have produced a scene or whether any unseen artifact exists.
